library: AI and See Why Keyword Library

keywords.name: 16mm Film Look
keywords.definition: Grainy, slightly soft small-gauge film texture; indie warmth and imperfection.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for memory sequences, music videos, and handmade honesty.
keywords.prompt_example: "16mm film look, summer lake, grain and halation"

keywords.name: 3D Pavement Art
keywords.definition: Anamorphic chalk illusions on streets that leap into three dimensions from one viewpoint.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful trompe-l'oeil scenes and street-art spectacle.
keywords.prompt_example: "3d pavement art of a waterfall in a plaza"

keywords.name: Abject Art
keywords.definition: Art confronting the discomforting side of the body and decay; beauty's uneasy shadow.
keywords.when_to_use: Use sparingly, for visceral, boundary-pushing fine-art concepts.
keywords.prompt_example: "still life of wilted flowers and spilled milk, abject art"

keywords.name: Abstract Futuristic
keywords.definition: Sleek non-representational forms suggesting speed, tech, and tomorrow: chrome curves and light trails.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for backgrounds, branding, and tech-forward abstract pieces.
keywords.prompt_example: "abstract futuristic composition, chrome and light"

keywords.name: Abstract Romanticism
keywords.definition: Romanticism's awe and emotion expressed through pure shape and color instead of scenery.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for emotional abstracts that swell like landscapes without depicting one.
keywords.prompt_example: "abstract romanticism, storm of color and light"

keywords.name: Abstract Tech
keywords.definition: Circuitry, data, and interface shapes abstracted into pattern and texture.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tech-brand backgrounds and digital-native abstract art.
keywords.prompt_example: "abstract tech pattern, circuit texture"

keywords.name: Acid Art
keywords.definition: Psychedelic intensity: melting patterns, electric color, perception turned up too far.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for trippy posters and hallucinatory landscapes.
keywords.prompt_example: "melting forest, acid art, electric colors"

keywords.name: Acidwave
keywords.definition: Vaporwave's harsher cousin: acid-bright gradients, warped grids, digital hallucination.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-digital posters with aggressive color.
keywords.prompt_example: "sunset grid landscape, acidwave"

keywords.name: Aerial Shot
keywords.definition: High drone or helicopter perspective, moving above the world.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for geography, spectacle, and god's-eye storytelling.
keywords.prompt_example: "aerial shot over the coastline at dawn"

keywords.name: Afrovictorian
keywords.definition: Victorian silhouettes and tailoring celebrated through African fabrics, patterns, and presence.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for regal historical-fusion portraits rich in pattern and dignity.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait of a duchess, afrovictorian style"

keywords.name: Algorave
keywords.definition: Live-coded rave visuals: generative geometry pulsing to algorithmic beats.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for music-visual backdrops and code-driven motion energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "algorave visuals, generative geometry, strobe"

keywords.name: Algorithmic Art
keywords.definition: Art generated by rules and code: systems produce the image, the artist designs the system.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for generative patterns and mathematical beauty.
keywords.prompt_example: "generative pattern, algorithmic art, flowing curves"

keywords.name: Alternative
keywords.definition: Umbrella counterculture styling: band tees, piercings, DIY edge across subcultures.
keywords.when_to_use: Use as a modifier for portraits that should read outside the mainstream.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, alternative fashion, 35mm"

keywords.name: Analog
keywords.definition: Pre-digital texture: film grain, tape warble, prints with real physical history.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to warm digital images with tangible imperfection.
keywords.prompt_example: "kitchen scene, analog photo, 1979"

keywords.name: Anamorphic
keywords.definition: Widescreen lenses with oval bokeh, horizontal flares, and gentle edge stretch; instant cinema.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when footage should feel like a theatrical film rather than a video.
keywords.prompt_example: "anamorphic lens, horizontal blue flare across the frame"

keywords.name: Anamorphic Art
keywords.definition: Distorted imagery that resolves correctly only from a specific angle or reflection.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for perspective-trick compositions and hidden-image concepts.
keywords.prompt_example: "anamorphic skull, oblique perspective"

keywords.name: Anglo Gothic
keywords.definition: English gothic flavor: stone churches, misty moors, ravens, and restrained dread.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for literary-gothic landscapes and portraits with British weather in their bones.
keywords.prompt_example: "manor on the moors, anglo gothic"

keywords.name: Angura Kei
keywords.definition: Japanese underground theatre fashion: dark vintage kimono elements, dramatic makeup, Showa-era shadow.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for theatrical dark-fashion portraits with Japanese vintage roots.
keywords.prompt_example: "stage portrait, angura kei style"

keywords.name: Antique Grunge
keywords.definition: Aged elegance gone beautifully to seed: peeling gilt, foxed paper, dusty velvet.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for interiors and still lifes that should feel abandoned but grand.
keywords.prompt_example: "abandoned ballroom, antique grunge"

keywords.name: Arc Shot
keywords.definition: The camera curves part of the way around the subject.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to bring a still moment to life, or to show a new side of someone.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow arc around her as she reads the letter"

keywords.name: Art Deco Era
keywords.definition: The glamorous 1920s-30s look: geometric patterns, gold and black, luxury and symmetry.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegance, posters, architecture, and Gatsby-flavored glamour.
keywords.prompt_example: "art deco hotel lobby, gold and black, symmetrical"

keywords.name: Art Povera
keywords.definition: Italian movement making art from humble materials: rags, soil, rope, found scraps as fine art.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for textured, materials-first compositions that feel honest and raw.
keywords.prompt_example: "sculpture of a horse, arte povera style"

keywords.name: Artificial Nature
keywords.definition: Nature rebuilt synthetically: plastic flowers, LED forests, lab-grown landscapes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for uncanny eco-futurist scenes questioning what counts as natural.
keywords.prompt_example: "garden of plastic flowers, artificial nature"

keywords.name: ASCII Art
keywords.definition: Pictures drawn entirely with keyboard characters; terminal-era charm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-computing graphics and text-as-image pieces.
keywords.prompt_example: "cat portrait, ascii art"

keywords.name: Assemblage
keywords.definition: Three-dimensional collage: sculptures built from found objects glued into new meaning.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for textured mixed-object compositions and cabinet-of-curiosities energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait built from vintage objects, assemblage art"

keywords.name: Atmospheric Haze
keywords.definition: Light hangs in the air and the distance fades into soft mist.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for depth, mood and visible beams of light.
keywords.prompt_example: "atmospheric haze, morning light cutting through the trees"

keywords.name: Atmospheric Landscape Painting
keywords.definition: Landscapes where air is the subject: haze, depth, and weather doing the storytelling.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for layered vistas with palpable distance and mood.
keywords.prompt_example: "valley in morning haze, atmospheric landscape painting"

keywords.name: Augmented Reality Art
keywords.definition: Art designed to overlay the physical world: floating layers, digital ghosts in real space.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for mixed-reality concepts and holographic scene ideas.
keywords.prompt_example: "sculpture as AR overlay in a park, augmented reality art"

keywords.name: Avant-Pop Surrealism
keywords.definition: Pop-culture imagery bent into dream logic: glossy, strange, and saturated.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for editorial-weird portraits and album-cover energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait with melting television, avant-pop surrealism"

keywords.name: Background Swap
keywords.definition: The subject stays exactly in place while the world behind them changes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to show time passing or a life changing around one person.
keywords.prompt_example: "he stays still while the background cuts from beach to city to snow"

keywords.name: Barococo
keywords.definition: Baroque drama plus rococo froth: maximum ornament, zero restraint.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when opulence should be turned past tasteful on purpose.
keywords.prompt_example: "palace hall, barococo style, gold everything"

keywords.name: Baroque
keywords.definition: Seventeenth-century drama: deep shadow, rich fabric, motion and emotion at full volume.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for theatrical portraits and opulent scenes with serious lighting.
keywords.prompt_example: "banquet scene, baroque painting, dramatic light"

keywords.name: Binary Art
keywords.definition: Imagery built from 1s and 0s: code as texture, data as portrait.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tech subjects and digital-identity themes.
keywords.prompt_example: "face formed from binary code, binary art"

keywords.name: Bioluminescence
keywords.definition: Natural glow from living things, like glowing mushrooms, plankton, or deep-sea creatures. Magical and otherworldly.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for fantasy scenes, night nature, and anything that should feel softly magical without being cartoonish.
keywords.prompt_example: "midnight forest floor, bioluminescent mushrooms"

keywords.name: Biomechanical Art
keywords.definition: Flesh fused with machine in intricate detail; Giger-adjacent dark elegance.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dark sci-fi characters and ornate machine-organism designs.
keywords.prompt_example: "biomechanical portrait, intricate detail"

keywords.name: Biomorphic Art
keywords.definition: Abstract forms echoing living shapes: amoebas, kidneys, curves that feel grown not drawn.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for soft organic abstraction and mid-century-flavored forms.
keywords.prompt_example: "biomorphic abstract shapes, matisse cutout energy"

keywords.name: Biopunk Rococo
keywords.definition: Ornate 18th-century curls and gilding grown from living tissue, vines, and organic machinery. Lavish and unsettling in the best way.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for high-concept fantasy, album art, and scenes where beauty should feel slightly alive.
keywords.prompt_example: "biopunk rococo throne room, living gold filigree"

keywords.name: Bird's-Eye View
keywords.definition: Looking straight down from above.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for patterns, maps, choreography, or a calm god's-eye distance.
keywords.prompt_example: "bird's-eye view of the dancers forming a circle"

keywords.name: Bleach Bypass
keywords.definition: Desaturated, high-contrast silvery look from skipping the bleach step; war-film grit.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for harsh memories, conflict, and drained worlds.
keywords.prompt_example: "trench sequence, bleach bypass grade"

keywords.name: Bokeh
keywords.definition: Out-of-focus highlights rendered as soft glowing discs; blur as decoration.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for romantic night scenes and gentle backgrounds full of city lights.
keywords.prompt_example: "night portrait, street lamps as soft bokeh"

keywords.name: Botanical Art
keywords.definition: Precise, loving plant illustration in the tradition of scientific field guides.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant plant studies, wall art, and herbarium moods.
keywords.prompt_example: "botanical art plate, foxglove study"

keywords.name: Brushed Metal
keywords.definition: Metal with a fine, satiny grain instead of a mirror shine. Modern, clean, industrial.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for product shots, tech, and modern interiors when chrome feels too flashy.
keywords.prompt_example: "brushed metal coffee machine, morning kitchen light"

keywords.name: Brutalist Botanical
keywords.definition: Massive raw concrete forms softened by wild, overflowing plant life. Cold architecture, warm nature, perfect tension.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for architecture content, book covers, and solarpunk-adjacent worldbuilding.
keywords.prompt_example: "brutalist botanical tower, concrete and hanging gardens"

keywords.name: Bubble Bujo
keywords.definition: Bullet-journal bubble lettering: rounded, bold, friendly letterforms and sticker-like flourishes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for hand-lettered headers, planners, and cheerful typographic art.
keywords.prompt_example: "title page lettering, bubble bujo style"

keywords.name: Bubble Goth
keywords.definition: Goth cheerfulness: black-and-neon palettes, glossy textures, cute darkness invented by pop artist Kerli.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when gothic subjects need bounce, shine, and a bit of bubblegum.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, bubble goth aesthetic, pastel and black"

keywords.name: Camera Roll
keywords.definition: The camera rotates around its own lens, tipping the whole picture over.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dizziness, dream logic, or a world turning upside down.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera rolls a full turn as it pushes toward her"

keywords.name: Candid
keywords.definition: Unposed, caught-in-the-moment photography. Real expressions, imperfect framing, honest life.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when posed images feel stiff. Perfect for storytelling and documentary feels.
keywords.prompt_example: "candid photo of friends laughing at a kitchen table"

keywords.name: Candlelight
keywords.definition: Warm, flickering, intimate light from a small flame. Everything feels closer and quieter.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy, romantic, or historical scenes. It naturally darkens the edges of the frame.
keywords.prompt_example: "handwritten letter on a desk, candlelight"

keywords.name: Caricature
keywords.definition: Exaggerated portraiture that amplifies a subject's most recognizable features with affection.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for humorous portraits and editorial cartooning.
keywords.prompt_example: "caricature of a chef, exaggerated features"

keywords.name: Cartoon
keywords.definition: Simplified, exaggerated character rendering with bold outlines and expressive features.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for friendly characters, mascots, and anything meant to make people smile fast.
keywords.prompt_example: "cartoon dog chef, simple shapes"

keywords.name: Charcoal Sketch
keywords.definition: Loose, smudgy black drawing with rough strokes and soft shading. Raw and expressive.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for emotion, movement studies, and dramatic portraits where polish would kill the feeling.
keywords.prompt_example: "charcoal sketch of a dancer mid-leap"

keywords.name: Chiaroscuro
keywords.definition: An old painting term for dramatic light against deep shadow. Think candlelit faces in dark rooms, Rembrandt style.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for moody portraits, mystery, and drama. Not for cheerful scenes; it will darken everything.
keywords.prompt_example: "violinist in an empty theatre, chiaroscuro"

keywords.name: Chic Modernist
keywords.definition: Clean modernist design with fashion polish: neutral palettes, sculptural furniture, quiet money.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sophisticated interiors and minimalist lifestyle scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "living room, chic modernist interior"

keywords.name: Child's Drawing
keywords.definition: Deliberately naive crayon-and-marker rendering: wobbly lines, wrong proportions, pure joy.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for innocence, humor, or emotionally disarming contrast.
keywords.prompt_example: "family portrait, child's crayon drawing"

keywords.name: Chiptune
keywords.definition: 8-bit game aesthetics: pixel color palettes, sprite logic, console-era charm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-game scenes and nostalgic pixel compositions.
keywords.prompt_example: "pixel city at night, chiptune aesthetic"

keywords.name: City Pop
keywords.definition: 1980s Japanese city-pop album art: airbrushed sunsets, convertibles, neon skylines, easy glamour.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for retro-cool urban scenes with a soundtrack you can almost hear.
keywords.prompt_example: "night drive, city pop album art, 1984"

keywords.name: Cityscape
keywords.definition: A wide view of a city: rooftops, lights, layers of buildings stacked to the horizon.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for establishing shots, urban energy, and scale.
keywords.prompt_example: "rainy cityscape at blue hour, glowing windows"

keywords.name: Claymation
keywords.definition: The look of hand-molded clay characters, with fingerprint softness and stop-motion charm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for friendly characters and nostalgic, handmade animation vibes.
keywords.prompt_example: "claymation robot watering a tiny garden"

keywords.name: Close-Up
keywords.definition: The face fills the frame; every flicker of feeling becomes the story.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for emotional beats, reactions, and decisive moments.
keywords.prompt_example: "close-up on his eyes as the verdict is read"

keywords.name: Cloudscape
keywords.definition: The sky as the whole scene: towering clouds, light beams, endless space.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for freedom, spirituality, and scale. Beautiful backdrop for flying subjects.
keywords.prompt_example: "golden cloudscape at sunset, birds crossing"

keywords.name: Colour Match Cut
keywords.definition: The frame fills with one colour, then cuts to something else of the same colour.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to link two unrelated scenes in a satisfying way.
keywords.prompt_example: "the frame fills with red paint, then cuts to a red umbrella in the rain"

keywords.name: Comic Art
keywords.definition: Bold inked panels, dynamic poses, halftone dots and action-ready composition.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for storytelling frames, hero shots, and graphic punch.
keywords.prompt_example: "superhero landing, comic art style"

keywords.name: Concrete Art
keywords.definition: Pure geometric abstraction with no reference to the real world; math made visual.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for clean, rational abstract pieces and modernist design work.
keywords.prompt_example: "geometric abstract, concrete art style"

keywords.name: Country
keywords.definition: Rural Americana warmth: barns, gingham, golden fields, porch-light hospitality.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for wholesome pastoral scenes and homestead moods.
keywords.prompt_example: "farmhouse kitchen, country style"

keywords.name: Cracked Porcelain
keywords.definition: Fine, delicate cracks across a smooth ceramic surface, like an antique teacup. Fragile beauty.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegance with a hint of sadness or age. Beautiful on faces in surreal art.
keywords.prompt_example: "porcelain doll face with fine cracks, soft light"

keywords.name: Crane Shot
keywords.definition: The camera sweeps vertically or in an arc from a raised arm, moving between ground level and overhead.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for grand reveals, openings, and moments that deserve scale.
keywords.prompt_example: "crane shot rising from the crowd to reveal the city"

keywords.name: Cross Dissolve
keywords.definition: One image melts into the next; time passing with a soft edge.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gentle time transitions and memory sequences.
keywords.prompt_example: "cross dissolve from her young face to the old photograph"

keywords.name: Cyber Fairy Grunge
keywords.definition: Fairy grunge wired into the machine: glitching wings, LED moss, digital decay over woodland whimsy.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tech-touched fantasy characters and glitchy forest scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "fairy with glitching wings, cyber fairy grunge"

keywords.name: Cyberculture
keywords.definition: Internet-native visual culture: interfaces, avatars, meme textures, and screen-glow life.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for online-life commentary pieces and digital-era portraits.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait made of browser windows, cyberculture"

keywords.name: Cybergoth
keywords.definition: Goth fused with rave tech: black PVC, neon dreads, goggles, industrial club lighting.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for futuristic club scenes or characters equal parts dark and glowing.
keywords.prompt_example: "dancer portrait, cybergoth style, neon green"

keywords.name: Cybergrunge
keywords.definition: Digital decay aesthetics: corrupted textures, terminal green, grime rendered in pixels.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dystopian graphics and anti-polish digital art.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, cybergrunge, glitch texture"

keywords.name: Cybernetic Punk
keywords.definition: Flesh-and-machine rebellion: visible implants, wires, dystopian grit with attitude.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for hard sci-fi characters and street-level future scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait with cybernetic arm, cyberpunk street"

keywords.name: Day for Night
keywords.definition: Daylight footage graded into moonlight: cool, dim, and slightly unreal.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for stylized night scenes with dreamlike readability.
keywords.prompt_example: "day for night grade, silver-blue orchard"

keywords.name: Decalcomania
keywords.definition: Paint pressed between surfaces and pulled apart, leaving branching accidental textures surrealists loved.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for organic abstract textures and dreamlike landscapes.
keywords.prompt_example: "alien landscape, decalcomania texture"

keywords.name: Deep Focus
keywords.definition: Everything from foreground to horizon stays sharp; layers of story in one frame.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for staging action in depth and letting viewers choose where to look.
keywords.prompt_example: "deep focus, argument in front, children playing far behind"

keywords.name: Derivative Art
keywords.definition: Art deliberately made from other art: remix, homage, and quotation as method.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for style-mashup experiments and commentary pieces.
keywords.prompt_example: "famous painting reimagined, derivative art remix"

keywords.name: Digital Animation
keywords.definition: Rendered motion-picture styling: smooth gradients, expressive characters, animated-feature polish.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for stills that should look like frames from an animated film.
keywords.prompt_example: "animated film still, cozy village morning"

keywords.name: Digital Impressionism
keywords.definition: Impressionist brushwork born digital: loose light-dabbed strokes with modern color freedom.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for painterly scenes with soft edges and glowing light.
keywords.prompt_example: "harbor at dawn, digital impressionism"

keywords.name: Dolly In
keywords.definition: The camera physically glides toward the subject on a track. Unlike a zoom, the world shifts around them, pulling the viewer closer emotionally.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for slow realizations, rising tension, or drawing attention to a decision on someone's face.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow dolly in on her face as she reads the letter"

keywords.name: Dolly Kei
keywords.definition: Japanese street fashion built from antique European dolls: layered vintage fabrics, religious motifs, dark fairy-tale trims.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for richly layered vintage fashion portraits with a storybook shadow.
keywords.prompt_example: "fashion portrait, dolly kei style"

keywords.name: Dolly Out
keywords.definition: The camera glides away from the subject, revealing context and often leaving them small in their world.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for endings, isolation, or the reveal that changes everything.
keywords.prompt_example: "dolly out from the empty chair, room grows around it"

keywords.name: Dolly Zoom
keywords.definition: Dolly and zoom in opposite directions: the subject stays put while the background stretches. Vertigo in a lens.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dread, revelation, and the ground falling out from under someone.
keywords.prompt_example: "dolly zoom on his face as he understands"

keywords.name: Doodle
keywords.definition: Playful margin-of-the-notebook drawing: loose, dense, and cheerfully unserious.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for pattern fills, sticker sheets, and hand-drawn warmth.
keywords.prompt_example: "page of doodles, coffee theme"

keywords.name: Dreamscape
keywords.definition: A landscape built from dream logic: floating islands, impossible skies, soft physics.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when reality is optional. Great for surreal art and emotional storytelling.
keywords.prompt_example: "pastel dreamscape with floating staircases and slow clouds"

keywords.name: Dual Kawaii
keywords.definition: Split-personality cute: one half sweet pastels, the other half dark or edgy, in a single design.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for character designs that need contrast or before-and-after energy in one frame.
keywords.prompt_example: "character sheet, dual kawaii style, half pastel half black"

keywords.name: Dutch Angle
keywords.definition: The horizon tilts off-level; the world is subtly, deliberately wrong.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for unease, disorientation, and villain energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "dutch angle as the lights flicker in the corridor"

keywords.name: Eco Art
keywords.definition: Environment-centered art practice: living materials, land collaboration, ecological storytelling.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for nature-advocacy concepts and land-based installations.
keywords.prompt_example: "river cleaned into an artwork, eco art installation"

keywords.name: Editorial
keywords.definition: Magazine-style photography: intentional, styled, confident. Every element placed on purpose.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for fashion, products, and brand imagery that should feel premium.
keywords.prompt_example: "editorial photo of a woman in a structured coat, studio"

keywords.name: Emo
keywords.definition: Early-2000s mall goth mood: black layers, side-swept fringe, checkerboard, eyeliner, and feelings.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for nostalgic 2000s portraits or moody youth-culture scenes with a soft heart.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait of a teenager, emo aesthetic, 2005"

keywords.name: Encaustic Art
keywords.definition: Painting with molten pigmented wax: luminous layers, fused textures, ancient technique.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for richly textured abstract or portrait surfaces with depth and glow.
keywords.prompt_example: "seascape, encaustic painting, layered wax"

keywords.name: Establishing Shot
keywords.definition: An opening view that tells the audience where and when they are before anything happens.
keywords.when_to_use: Use at scene starts and location changes.
keywords.prompt_example: "establishing shot, rain-soaked neon street, midnight"

keywords.name: Ethereal
keywords.definition: Light, airy, and not quite of this world. Glow, softness, and a floating feeling.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to lift any scene toward the magical. One of the strongest single-word mood shifters.
keywords.prompt_example: "ethereal portrait, soft glow, floating fabric"

keywords.name: Expressionist Architecture
keywords.definition: Buildings as emotion: sweeping sculptural forms, distorted brick, structures that feel.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dramatic architectural scenes beyond rational modernism.
keywords.prompt_example: "concert hall, expressionist architecture"

keywords.name: Extreme Close-Up
keywords.definition: A single detail fills everything: an eye, a trembling hand, a turning key.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tension details and sensory intimacy.
keywords.prompt_example: "extreme close-up of the match striking"

keywords.name: Extreme Wide Shot
keywords.definition: The subject is tiny in a vast environment; landscape as the loudest voice.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for openings, isolation, and scale that words can't carry.
keywords.prompt_example: "extreme wide shot, lone figure crossing the salt flat"

keywords.name: Eye Level
keywords.definition: The camera sits at the subject's eye height, looking straight at them.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want the angle to feel neutral and honest.
keywords.prompt_example: "eye-level shot of her across the kitchen table"

keywords.name: Fade to Black
keywords.definition: The picture fades away to black.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for endings, chapter breaks and deliberate pauses. Not between every scene.
keywords.prompt_example: "final shot fades to black"

keywords.name: Fairy Academia
keywords.definition: Dark academia's bookish charm with mushrooms, moth wings, and forest-library light.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for scholarly-magical scenes: old books, candlelight, and something watching from the ferns.
keywords.prompt_example: "reading nook in a hollow tree, fairy academia"

keywords.name: Fairy Grunge
keywords.definition: Woodland whimsy dragged through the mud: fairy wings and lace with dirt, moss, and distressed layers.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want magic that looks lived-in rather than polished.
keywords.prompt_example: "forest wanderer, fairy grunge aesthetic"

keywords.name: Fauvism
keywords.definition: Wild early-modern color: nature painted in unapologetic, non-realistic hues.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for joyful high-saturation landscapes and portraits.
keywords.prompt_example: "harbor scene, fauvism, wild color"

keywords.name: Faux Naif Art
keywords.definition: Trained artists painting deliberately childlike; sophistication wearing innocence.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for knowing-whimsical scenes with naive charm and sly craft.
keywords.prompt_example: "city street, faux naif painting"

keywords.name: Figurative Expressionism
keywords.definition: Human figures painted with raw, emotional distortion; feeling over anatomy.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for intense portraits where the paint carries the psychology.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, figurative expressionism, heavy impasto"

keywords.name: Film Photography
keywords.definition: The analog look: gentle grain, imperfect color, soft highlights. Warmth digital can't fake.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for nostalgia and humanity. Makes AI images feel less AI.
keywords.prompt_example: "film photography of a seaside town, slight grain"

keywords.name: First Snow
keywords.definition: Light, fresh snowfall that hasn't been walked through yet. Clean, quiet, hopeful.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for winter softness without harshness, and for scenes about new beginnings.
keywords.prompt_example: "red postbox under first snow, early morning"

keywords.name: Flash to White
keywords.definition: The frame blows out to white from a real light, then fades into the next shot.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for memories, revelations and impact.
keywords.prompt_example: "a camera flash fires and the white fades into the next scene"

keywords.name: Fog
keywords.definition: Thick soft mist that hides distance and mutes color. The world becomes quiet and mysterious.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to simplify busy scenes, add mystery, or make light rays visible.
keywords.prompt_example: "lone streetlamp in heavy fog"

keywords.name: Folk Art
keywords.definition: Traditional community art forms: handmade, decorative, passed down rather than taught in academies.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for warm cultural scenes and handcraft-textured illustration.
keywords.prompt_example: "painted wooden horses, folk art"

keywords.name: Follow Shot
keywords.definition: The camera follows behind someone as they move.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to take the viewer on the journey with your character.
keywords.prompt_example: "follow shot behind her as she walks into the crowd"

keywords.name: Foreground Wipe
keywords.definition: Something passes right in front of the lens and, as it clears, the scene behind has changed.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for a smooth one-take feel. One of the easiest transitions to get right in AI video.
keywords.prompt_example: "a blurred figure walks across the lens; as they clear frame we are in a new street"

keywords.name: Found Object Art
keywords.definition: Everyday objects recontextualized as art, duchampian mischief included.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for conceptual still lifes and sculpture from the junk drawer.
keywords.prompt_example: "sculpture of a bird from spoons, found object art"

keywords.name: Found Text Art
keywords.definition: Compositions built from scavenged words: newspaper cutouts, old letters, ransom-note poetry.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for typographic collage and text-driven emotional pieces.
keywords.prompt_example: "poem made of newspaper cutouts, found text art"

keywords.name: FPV Drone
keywords.definition: Fast first-person drone flight: the camera is the drone, diving and banking through space.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for adrenaline, and for paths no person could ever fly.
keywords.prompt_example: "FPV drone dives off the cliff and skims the waves"

keywords.name: Freeze Frame
keywords.definition: The picture freezes on a peak moment, then the next shot starts from that same pose.
keywords.when_to_use: Use as a pattern break, a punchline or a 'that's me' moment.
keywords.prompt_example: "she leaps; the frame freezes at the top of the jump"

keywords.name: Full Shot
keywords.definition: The whole person from head to feet, nothing cut off.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to show an outfit, a pose, a dance move or a full action.
keywords.prompt_example: "full shot of the dancer mid-leap"

keywords.name: Funk Art
keywords.definition: Irreverent 1960s California movement: crude, funny, ceramic-heavy anti-elegance.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful, rude-on-purpose sculptural subjects.
keywords.prompt_example: "ceramic sculpture of a hamburger, funk art"

keywords.name: Furry Art
keywords.definition: Anthropomorphic animal character art with expressive, stylized designs.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for anthro character commissions-style renders and mascot design.
keywords.prompt_example: "anthropomorphic fox character, furry art style"

keywords.name: Glide
keywords.definition: A slow, weightless drift past the subject, as if carried on a breeze.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dreamy, hypnotic, music-video moods.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow weightless glide past her through the flower field"

keywords.name: Glitch Transition
keywords.definition: A burst of digital distortion covers the cut.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tech, gaming and AI topics. Best added in the edit rather than prompted.
keywords.prompt_example: "add in the edit: a two-frame RGB glitch between the shots"

keywords.name: Golden Autumn
keywords.definition: Peak fall: amber leaves, low warm sun, long shadows. Cozy and a little nostalgic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for warmth, harvest scenes, and gentle melancholy.
keywords.prompt_example: "golden autumn park, falling leaves, long shadows"

keywords.name: Golden Hour
keywords.definition: The warm, honey-colored light you get just after sunrise or before sunset. It makes everything look softer, kinder, and more expensive.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when you want instant warmth and beauty with one word. If a prompt feels flat, this is the first thing to try.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait of a gardener, golden hour light"

keywords.name: Golden Hour Grade
keywords.definition: Warm amber light of the sun's first and last hour, honeyed and forgiving.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for romance, nostalgia, and endings that feel earned.
keywords.prompt_example: "golden hour grade, field at last light"

keywords.name: Gond Painting
keywords.definition: Central Indian tribal art: animals and trees filled with rhythmic dot-and-dash patterns.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for pattern-rich nature illustration honoring the Gond tradition.
keywords.prompt_example: "tree of life, gond painting style"

keywords.name: Gothic Americana
keywords.definition: American gothic dread: lonely farmhouses, crows on wires, faith and dust.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for rural-dark storytelling scenes and southern-gothic moods.
keywords.prompt_example: "farmhouse at dusk, gothic americana"

keywords.name: Gothic Kawaii
keywords.definition: Cute meets creepy: pastel bats, smiling ghosts, lace and skulls in candy colors. Wednesday Addams meets Lisa Frank.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful dark content, stickers, and brand imagery with bite.
keywords.prompt_example: "gothic kawaii ghost tea party, pastel and black lace"

keywords.name: Graffiti Pop Art
keywords.definition: Lowbrow street-pop blend: playful characters, bold outlines, KAWS-adjacent attitude.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for urban-pop characters and gallery-street crossover pieces.
keywords.prompt_example: "character mural, graffiti pop art"

keywords.name: Graffito
keywords.definition: Scratched-surface mark-making: images incised into plaster, paint, or stone.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for raw wall-texture art and ancient-meets-street surfaces.
keywords.prompt_example: "figures scratched into plaster wall, graffito"

keywords.name: Ground Level
keywords.definition: The lens sits right on the floor, looking along it.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for feet, things rolling past, or a creature's-eye view.
keywords.prompt_example: "ground-level shot as the skateboard rolls toward us"

keywords.name: Grunge
keywords.definition: Worn, layered, deliberately undone: flannel, ripped denim, faded film texture, a little grime.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to rough up a scene that feels too clean or add 90s attitude.
keywords.prompt_example: "street portrait, grunge aesthetic, 35mm film"

keywords.name: Haida Art
keywords.definition: Pacific Northwest Indigenous formline art: bold ovoids, split forms, powerful crest animals.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for striking formline animal designs in the Haida tradition.
keywords.prompt_example: "raven design, haida formline art"

keywords.name: Hand Over Lens
keywords.definition: Hands cover the lens, then open on a new scene.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful resets and reveals.
keywords.prompt_example: "she covers the lens with both hands; as they part she is somewhere new"

keywords.name: Handheld
keywords.definition: Unstabilized camera with natural shake and drift; human, urgent, imperfect.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for documentary realism, panic, or intimacy that polish would flatten.
keywords.prompt_example: "handheld camera, kitchen argument, urgent energy"

keywords.name: Hard Edge Painting
keywords.definition: Crisp geometric color fields with razor-clean boundaries; no brushwork, no blending.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for bold graphic compositions and modernist poster energy.
keywords.prompt_example: "abstract composition, hard edge painting"

keywords.name: Hard Light
keywords.definition: Small, direct sources casting crisp shadows and sharp texture; unforgiving and graphic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for noir edges, desert sun, and faces with history.
keywords.prompt_example: "hard light across his face, blinds striping shadow"

keywords.name: Harlem Renaissance
keywords.definition: 1920s Black American artistic flowering: jazz-age portraiture, bold dignity, rhythmic composition.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for celebratory historical portraits and jazz-era scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "jazz club scene, harlem renaissance painting"

keywords.name: Heat Haze
keywords.definition: The shimmery, wavy air above hot roads and deserts. You can feel the temperature.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for deserts, summer roads, and tension. It adds motion to still scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "empty desert highway, heat haze on the horizon"

keywords.name: High Angle
keywords.definition: Camera looks down, diminishing the subject or mapping the scene.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for vulnerability, surveillance moods, or clear spatial layouts.
keywords.prompt_example: "high angle on the child lost in the crowd"

keywords.name: High Fashion
keywords.definition: Editorial runway polish: dramatic styling, sculptural garments, magazine-cover confidence.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for fashion editorials and portraits that should look expensive.
keywords.prompt_example: "editorial portrait, high fashion, avant-garde gown"

keywords.name: High-Key Lighting
keywords.definition: Bright, even, nearly shadowless illumination; open and optimistic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for comedy, commercials, and worlds without secrets.
keywords.prompt_example: "morning kitchen scene, high-key lighting"

keywords.name: Hopi Art
keywords.definition: Hopi visual tradition: kachina imagery, pottery motifs, desert palettes with deep symbolism.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for respectful Southwest-rooted pattern and pottery scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "pottery motifs, hopi art tradition"

keywords.name: Hyperspace Noir
keywords.definition: Detective-story shadow in deep space: neon-lit starships, trench coats among the stars.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sci-fi mystery scenes with hardboiled mood.
keywords.prompt_example: "detective on a space station, hyperspace noir"

keywords.name: Iconography
keywords.definition: Symbol-dense sacred-art styling: gold leaf, flat perspective, figures loaded with meaning.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for reverent stylized portraits and symbolic compositions.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait in byzantine iconography style, gold leaf"

keywords.name: Illustration
keywords.definition: General illustrated rendering: visible artistic interpretation rather than photographic realism.
keywords.when_to_use: Use as a base style word when you want drawn, not photographed.
keywords.prompt_example: "cottage by a river, illustration"

keywords.name: Insert Shot
keywords.definition: A quick cut to one small detail: a text message, a ring, a button.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to hand the viewer one important piece of information fast.
keywords.prompt_example: "insert shot of her phone lighting up with a message"

keywords.name: Iridescent
keywords.definition: A surface that shifts colors as it catches light, like soap bubbles, beetle shells, or oil on water.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for magic, luxury, and dreamlike surfaces. A little goes a long way.
keywords.prompt_example: "iridescent silk gown, studio light"

keywords.name: J-Cut
keywords.definition: The next scene's sound arrives before its picture; audio leads the way in.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for smooth scene flow and anticipation.
keywords.prompt_example: "J-cut: the crowd noise rises before we see the stadium"

keywords.name: Jewel Tones
keywords.definition: Deep, saturated colors named after gems: emerald, ruby, sapphire, amethyst. Rich and confident.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for luxury, drama, and depth. They love dark backgrounds and velvet textures.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait in jewel tones, emerald background"

keywords.name: Jump Cut
keywords.definition: The camera stays put while time jumps between cuts, so things pop in, out or around.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for routines, comedy and fast montages.
keywords.prompt_example: "jump cuts on a locked frame as more friends appear beside her"

keywords.name: Kangra Painting
keywords.definition: Himalayan miniature school: lyrical romance scenes, delicate faces, lush green landscapes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for tender miniature-style narrative scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "lovers in a garden, kangra miniature painting"

keywords.name: Karesansui
keywords.definition: Japanese dry rock garden aesthetic: raked gravel, placed stones, emptiness as design.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for meditative minimal scenes and zen-garden compositions.
keywords.prompt_example: "karesansui rock garden, raked gravel, dawn"

keywords.name: Kawaii Gamer
keywords.definition: Cute-culture meets gaming setup: pastel peripherals, plushies, RGB glow softened into candy colors.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for cozy tech scenes, streamer aesthetics, or anything that should feel playful and plugged-in.
keywords.prompt_example: "desk setup, kawaii gamer aesthetic, pastel pink"

keywords.name: Kinetic Art
keywords.definition: Art built around real or implied movement: spinning, swaying, optically vibrating forms.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for compositions that need motion energy in a still frame.
keywords.prompt_example: "kinetic sculpture in a plaza, sense of motion"

keywords.name: Kishangarh Painting
keywords.definition: Rajasthani miniature style famed for elongated eyes and elegant, lotus-like profiles.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for graceful miniature portraits in the Bani Thani tradition.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait in kishangarh miniature style"

keywords.name: L-Cut
keywords.definition: The previous scene's audio lingers over the new image; sound refuses to leave.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for reactions carrying into consequences and conversational flow.
keywords.prompt_example: "L-cut: her words continue over his face at the window"

keywords.name: Land Art
keywords.definition: Earth itself as medium: spirals of stone, lines in desert, art at landscape scale.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for monumental outdoor interventions and aerial-view earthworks.
keywords.prompt_example: "stone spiral in a salt flat, land art, aerial view"

keywords.name: Lens Flare
keywords.definition: Light strikes the lens directly, blooming into streaks and ghosts.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for sun-kissed warmth, sci-fi shine, or dreamy interruptions.
keywords.prompt_example: "backlit runner, warm lens flare crossing frame"

keywords.name: Light Leak
keywords.definition: A warm wash of light sweeps across and covers the cut.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for weddings, lifestyle and dreamy beauty edits. Best added in the edit.
keywords.prompt_example: "add in the edit: a warm light leak sweeping across the cut"

keywords.name: Light Match Cut
keywords.definition: A light flares to white, and the next shot opens on a light in the same spot.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for time jumps and dreamy montages.
keywords.prompt_example: "the lantern flares to white; the next shot is a street lamp in the same place"

keywords.name: Lilac Femme
keywords.definition: Soft feminine styling built around lilac and lavender tones: dreamy, gentle, unapologetically pretty.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for portraits and flat-lays that need a signature purple softness.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, lilac femme aesthetic"

keywords.name: Line Drawing
keywords.definition: Clean continuous linework with minimal or no shading; elegance through economy.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for minimalist portraits, logos, and single-line sophistication.
keywords.prompt_example: "one line drawing of two hands"

keywords.name: Long Exposure
keywords.definition: A slow camera that turns motion into smooth streaks: silky waterfalls, light trails, ghost crowds.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for movement, time, and calm. Water and traffic become magic.
keywords.prompt_example: "long exposure waterfall in a dark forest"

keywords.name: Long Take
keywords.definition: One unbroken shot that runs far longer than expected; no cuts, no escape.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for immersion, tension, or showcasing choreography honestly.
keywords.prompt_example: "long take through the kitchen during dinner rush"

keywords.name: Low Angle
keywords.definition: Camera looks up at the subject, lending power, menace, or myth.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to make characters loom and architecture tower.
keywords.prompt_example: "low angle on the CEO stepping from the car"

keywords.name: Low-Key Lighting
keywords.definition: Mostly shadow, sparse light, high contrast; noir's native language.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for mystery, dread, and moral ambiguity.
keywords.prompt_example: "interrogation room, low-key lighting, single lamp"

keywords.name: Low Poly Art
keywords.definition: Faceted geometric rendering from early 3D: subjects built from visible triangles.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for stylized game-art scenes and crystalline landscapes.
keywords.prompt_example: "mountain landscape, low poly art"

keywords.name: Luminism
keywords.definition: 1850-70 American style of glassy light and stillness: transparent skies, mirror water, hushed glow.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for serene luminous landscapes with polished, brushless calm.
keywords.prompt_example: "bay at sunset, luminism painting"

keywords.name: Lyrical Abstraction
keywords.definition: Gestural non-objective painting focused on color, brushwork, and feeling over structure.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for expressive flowing abstracts with painterly freedom.
keywords.prompt_example: "lyrical abstraction, sweeping blues and golds"

keywords.name: Macro Lens
keywords.definition: An extreme close lens for tiny details and textures.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to make something small feel huge.
keywords.prompt_example: "macro shot of a raindrop sliding down a leaf"

keywords.name: Macro Photography
keywords.definition: Extreme close-up photography where tiny things fill the frame: insect eyes, dew drops, fabric weave.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for detail, texture, and wonder. Backgrounds melt into soft blur automatically.
keywords.prompt_example: "macro photography of frost on a leaf"

keywords.name: Magnetic Art
keywords.definition: Patterns formed by magnetic force: iron filings, ferrofluid spikes, invisible fields made visible.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for scientific-abstract textures and liquid-metal forms.
keywords.prompt_example: "ferrofluid bloom, magnetic art, macro"

keywords.name: Mannerism
keywords.definition: Late-Renaissance elegance stretched strange: elongated figures, acidic color, sophisticated unease.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for stylized portraits with deliberate, graceful distortion.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait with elongated neck, mannerism style"

keywords.name: Match Cut
keywords.definition: Two shots joined by matching shape, motion, or idea; the edit itself tells a story.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant time jumps and thematic rhymes between scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "match cut from spinning coin to spinning ferris wheel"

keywords.name: Match on Action
keywords.definition: An action starts in one shot and finishes in the next.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for energy, comedy and cause and effect.
keywords.prompt_example: "she throws the ball at the lens and it lands in the next scene"

keywords.name: Medium Close-Up
keywords.definition: From the chest up: closer than a medium shot, looser than a close-up.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for conversations that should feel personal without getting in someone's face.
keywords.prompt_example: "medium close-up of him leaning in to whisper"

keywords.name: Medium Shot
keywords.definition: Framed roughly waist-up; the conversational workhorse of cinema.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dialogue, interviews, and balanced everyday coverage.
keywords.prompt_example: "medium shot, she leans on the counter, talking"

keywords.name: Memphis Group
keywords.definition: 1980s Italian design rebellion: squiggles, clashing pastels, terrazzo, geometry with a sense of humor.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful retro-design scenes and postmodern pattern joy.
keywords.prompt_example: "living room, memphis group design, 1985"

keywords.name: Microscape
keywords.definition: A tiny world shot like a landscape: moss becomes forest, dew becomes lakes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for wonder and fresh perspective. Familiar things become magical at ant scale.
keywords.prompt_example: "microscape of a mossy log, dew drops like ponds"

keywords.name: Mixed Media
keywords.definition: Multiple materials in one work: paint over collage over ink over fabric.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for layered, tactile compositions that resist a single technique.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, mixed media, paint and newspaper collage"

keywords.name: Monsoon Rain
keywords.definition: Heavy, dramatic, warm rain. Sheets of water, glossy streets, life carrying on under umbrellas.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for drama and atmosphere in city or tropical scenes. Reflections double the beauty.
keywords.prompt_example: "market street in monsoon rain, umbrellas glowing"

keywords.name: Mori Kei
keywords.definition: Forest-girl fashion: layered natural fabrics, earthy tones, dressed like you live in the woods gently.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for soft woodland portraits and slow-living scenes.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait in a birch forest, mori kei fashion"

keywords.name: Morph
keywords.definition: One scene smoothly reshapes into another.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for signature dream moments. Far easier in AI video than in traditional effects.
keywords.prompt_example: "the paper crane slowly reshapes into a white bird"

keywords.name: Moss Covered
keywords.definition: Soft green growth blanketing stone, wood, or forgotten things. Nature quietly taking over.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for enchanted forests, ruins, and anything that should feel ancient and alive.
keywords.prompt_example: "moss covered stone stairway into a forest"

keywords.name: Motivated Lighting
keywords.definition: Cinematic light that pretends to come from the scene's own sources, enhanced invisibly.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for polished realism where the lighting has an alibi.
keywords.prompt_example: "moonlight through blinds, motivated lighting"

keywords.name: Muted Palette
keywords.definition: Colors with the volume turned down: dusty, greyed, quiet tones. Sophisticated and calm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use when bright colors feel cheap or loud. Editorial and interior content loves this.
keywords.prompt_example: "muted palette living room, linen and clay tones"

keywords.name: Mythological
keywords.definition: Gods, monsters, and legends rendered with epic-narrative weight.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for grand mythic scenes across any culture's canon.
keywords.prompt_example: "sea god rising from waves, mythological painting"

keywords.name: Naive
keywords.definition: Untrained-artist charm: flattened perspective, honest color, sincerity over technique.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for folk-warm scenes that should feel handmade and heartfelt.
keywords.prompt_example: "village festival, naive art painting"

keywords.name: Naturaleza
keywords.definition: Lush nature-first styling: abundant flora, organic shapes, celebration of living green.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for verdant scenes where nature is the whole point.
keywords.prompt_example: "overgrown greenhouse, naturaleza style"

keywords.name: Neko
keywords.definition: Cat-eared characters and feline motifs from Japanese pop culture.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful anime-adjacent character designs.
keywords.prompt_example: "neko girl character, anime style"

keywords.name: Neo Dada
keywords.definition: 1950s-60s revival of dada mischief: everyday objects, irony, and anti-art gestures.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for conceptual collage and duchampian humor.
keywords.prompt_example: "sculpture of a painted tire, neo dada"

keywords.name: Neo Gothic
keywords.definition: Gothic architecture and mood revived with modern drama: pointed arches, tracery, contemporary darkness.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for architecture, interiors, or portraits that need cathedral-scale atmosphere.
keywords.prompt_example: "cathedral interior, neo gothic style"

keywords.name: Neo-Rococo
keywords.definition: Rococo's frills revived with modern self-awareness: pastel excess, ornamental overload, wink included.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful ornate interiors and fashion with maximalist charm.
keywords.prompt_example: "boudoir interior, neo-rococo, pastel gilt"

keywords.name: Neon Glow
keywords.definition: Electric, colorful light like city signs at night. Pinks, blues, and purples bouncing off wet streets and faces.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for nightlife, retro-future vibes, or anything that should feel electric and modern.
keywords.prompt_example: "ramen stall at midnight, neon glow"

keywords.name: Neon Noir
keywords.definition: Noir updated in saturated neon: wet streets reflecting pink and cyan signage.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for modern night-city stories with electric melancholy.
keywords.prompt_example: "rain-slick alley, neon noir grade"

keywords.name: New Romantic
keywords.definition: 1980s flamboyant glamour: ruffles, drama makeup, synth-pop theatricality.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for bold retro fashion portraits with stage presence.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait, new romantic fashion, 1981"

keywords.name: Night Luxe
keywords.definition: After-dark glamour: champagne gold on black, city lights, velvet ropes and expensive shadows.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for nightlife scenes, luxury branding, and evening-event moods.
keywords.prompt_example: "rooftop bar at night, night luxe aesthetic"

keywords.name: Noir Grade
keywords.definition: Deep blacks, silver highlights, venetian-blind shadows; crime cinema's monochrome soul.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for detective stories and moral shadow, color optional.
keywords.prompt_example: "office at night, noir grade, blinds shadow"

keywords.name: Object-Oriented Ontology
keywords.definition: Philosophy-flavored art where things have inner lives: objects depicted as if they matter without us.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for uncanny still lifes where the furniture seems to be thinking.
keywords.prompt_example: "portrait of a chair alone in a field, object-oriented ontology"

keywords.name: Object Portal
keywords.definition: A ring, frame or lens held up to the camera shows the next scene inside it, and the camera pushes through.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to move into a new place or world in one playful move.
keywords.prompt_example: "a ring held up to the lens frames the beach; the camera pushes through it"

keywords.name: Oil Painting
keywords.definition: Rich, layered classical paint with visible brushwork and deep color. The museum look.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for portraits, drama, and timelessness. Instantly makes a scene feel important.
keywords.prompt_example: "oil painting of a woman with pink hair, dark background"

keywords.name: Ominous
keywords.definition: Something bad is coming. Heavy skies, long shadows, and quiet tension.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for thrillers, storms, and drama. It darkens mood without adding gore.
keywords.prompt_example: "ominous farmhouse under a green storm sky"

keywords.name: Ontology
keywords.definition: Being itself as subject: stark philosophical compositions about existence and thing-ness.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for minimal conceptual pieces with quiet existential weight.
keywords.prompt_example: "single door standing in a field, ontological art"

keywords.name: Opulent
keywords.definition: Extreme, unapologetic luxury. Gold, marble, abundance stacked on abundance.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for wealth, fantasy palaces, and maximalist beauty.
keywords.prompt_example: "opulent banquet table, gold candelabras, marble hall"

keywords.name: Orbit
keywords.definition: The camera circles the subject, holding them centered while the world wheels behind.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for hero moments, product beauty passes, and dizzying emotional peaks.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow orbit around the dancers, lights streaking behind"

keywords.name: Organic Abstraction
keywords.definition: Abstract forms borrowed from nature: cells, seeds, currents, growth without literal subjects.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for soft biomorphic compositions and nature-adjacent abstracts.
keywords.prompt_example: "organic abstraction, seed forms, cream and sage"

keywords.name: Orphism
keywords.definition: Early abstraction of luminous color circles and prisms; cubism gone chromatic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for radiant geometric abstracts built on color relationships.
keywords.prompt_example: "concentric color circles, orphism"

keywords.name: Over-the-Shoulder
keywords.definition: Framed past one character's shoulder onto another; conversation with built-in geography.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for dialogue scenes needing connection and spatial clarity.
keywords.prompt_example: "over-the-shoulder shot as she confronts him"

keywords.name: Overcast Light
keywords.definition: The soft, even light of a cloudy day. No harsh shadows, no squinting. Very flattering and calm.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for gentle, honest scenes and soft product shots. Great when harsh shadows keep ruining your image.
keywords.prompt_example: "woman reading on a porch, overcast light"

keywords.name: Palimpsest Art
keywords.definition: Layered surfaces where earlier marks ghost through newer ones: history visible in the overwrite.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for aged, story-laden textures and archaeological depth.
keywords.prompt_example: "wall of layered posters and paint, palimpsest art"

keywords.name: Pan
keywords.definition: The camera stays in one spot and turns left or right, like turning your head.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to follow someone across a room, or to reveal what is beside them.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow pan right across the busy market"

keywords.name: Papercraft
keywords.definition: Scenes built from cut, folded, and layered paper. Handmade, dimensional, and charming.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for playful explainers, craft aesthetics, and gentle 3D without computer-render coldness.
keywords.prompt_example: "papercraft diorama of a lighthouse in a storm"

keywords.name: Pareidolia

keywords.name: Post Conceptualism

keywords.name: Post-modernism

keywords.name: POV Shot
keywords.definition: The camera becomes a character's eyes; the audience wears their experience.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for immersion, horror peeks, and first-person storytelling.
keywords.prompt_example: "POV shot, hands opening the old journal"

keywords.name: Practical Lighting
keywords.definition: Scenes lit by sources visible in frame: lamps, neon signs, candles, screens.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for naturalistic night interiors and cozy realism.

keywords.name: Preppy
keywords.definition: Collegiate polish: navy blazers, tennis whites, plaid and old-money tidiness.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for clean-cut lifestyle scenes and classic campus moods.
keywords.prompt_example: "picnic on a lawn, preppy aesthetic"

keywords.name: Profile Shot
keywords.definition: The subject seen exactly side-on.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for silhouettes, faces deep in thought, or two people facing off.
keywords.prompt_example: "profile shot of him staring out of the train window"

keywords.name: Push In
keywords.definition: A gentle forward drift toward the subject, subtler than a full dolly move.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to quietly raise intensity inside dialogue or thought.

keywords.name: Push-Through
keywords.definition: The camera pushes into something dark and round, like a peephole or a hole, and comes out in the next scene.

keywords.prompt_example: "the camera pushes into the keyhole and comes out in the next room"

keywords.name: Rack Focus
keywords.definition: Focus glides from one subject to another mid-shot, steering attention like a hand on the chin.
keywords.when_to_use: Use to connect two story elements without cutting.
keywords.prompt_example: "rack focus from the wilting rose to her face"

keywords.name: Rayograms
keywords.definition: Camera-less photography: objects laid on photosensitive paper, captured as ghostly silhouettes.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for elegant photogram-style compositions in white on black.

keywords.name: Retro 70s
keywords.definition: Warm oranges and browns, funky patterns, film grain, and sun-faded optimism.

keywords.name: Retro Fairycore
keywords.definition: Fairycore filtered through 70s film: warm faded colors, vintage lace, sun-flare magic.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for nostalgic magical scenes that feel like an old photograph of something impossible.

keywords.name: Rim Light
keywords.definition: A thin outline of light around your subject's edges, like they're glowing from behind. Separates the subject from the background beautifully.

keywords.name: Rim Lighting
keywords.definition: Light from behind traces a bright edge around the subject, carving them from the dark.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for silhouettes with definition and heroic or mysterious outlines.

keywords.name: Rinpa
keywords.definition: Classical Japanese decorative school: gold-leaf grounds, stylized waves and blossoms, flat elegance.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for decorative nature scenes with museum-grade Japanese styling.

keywords.name: Rococo
keywords.definition: Eighteenth-century French lightness: pastel palettes, curling ornament, flirtatious ease.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for airy aristocratic scenes and decorative softness.

keywords.name: Rococo Revival
keywords.definition: Victorian-era rococo comeback: carved curves and ornament with heavier nineteenth-century polish.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for plush period interiors and ornate furniture scenes.

keywords.name: Romantic Academia
keywords.definition: Academia aesthetic warmed with poetry and longing: handwritten letters, roses on old books.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for soft scholarly scenes where the library is also a love story.
keywords.prompt_example: "desk with letters and roses, romantic academia"

keywords.name: Rough Sketch Line Drawing
keywords.definition: Loose, energetic pencil or ink lines that look mid-thought; construction lines welcome.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for concept-art energy or when polish would kill the charm.
keywords.prompt_example: "rough sketch line drawing of a dancer"

keywords.name: Salvage Art
keywords.definition: Art from rescued materials: driftwood, scrap metal, and discards given second lives.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for eco-craft sculpture concepts and weathered assemblage.

keywords.name: Seascape
keywords.definition: The ocean as the subject: waves, horizon, weather, and light on water.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for calm, power, or loneliness. The mood of the water is the mood of the image.
keywords.prompt_example: "stormy seascape with a distant lighthouse"

keywords.name: Serene
keywords.definition: Deep calm. Still water, soft light, nothing rushing anywhere.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for wellness, nature, and breathing room. The antidote to busy images.
keywords.prompt_example: "serene mountain lake at dawn, mist rising"

keywords.name: Shallow Depth of Field
keywords.definition: Razor-thin focus: the subject is sharp, the world melts into blur.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for portrait intimacy and isolating subjects from busy backgrounds.

keywords.name: Silhouette
keywords.definition: The subject reads as pure shape against a brighter background; identity through outline.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for mystery reveals, romantic dusk figures, and iconic frames.
keywords.prompt_example: "silhouette in the doorway, hallway blazing behind"

keywords.name: Slow Motion
keywords.definition: Time stretched: motion rendered at high frame rate and played back slow, every detail savored.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for impact moments, beauty passes, and emotional peaks.
keywords.prompt_example: "slow motion, confetti falling around the champion"

keywords.name: Smash Cut
keywords.definition: An abrupt jarring cut between extremes: loud to silent, calm to chaos.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for shock, comedy, and waking from dreams badly.
keywords.prompt_example: "smash cut from the scream to the quiet breakfast table"

keywords.name: Snap Zoom
keywords.definition: A split-second zoom from wide to tight.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for comedy beats, reactions and punchlines.

keywords.name: Soft Grunge

keywords.name: Soft Macabre

keywords.prompt_example: "still life with skull and roses, soft macabre"

keywords.name: Speed Ramp
keywords.definition: Footage accelerates or brakes mid-shot: real time snapping into slow motion and back.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for action emphasis and stylish energy shifts.
keywords.prompt_example: "speed ramp as the skater launches off the rail"

keywords.name: Speed Smear
keywords.definition: Something fast whips past the lens and its blur becomes the cut.

keywords.name: Spiral Shot
keywords.definition: The camera circles the subject while rising, like a corkscrew.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for grand reveals, dream moments and big emotional lifts.
keywords.prompt_example: "the camera spirals up around the dancer and rises above the stage"

keywords.name: Stained Glass
keywords.definition: Bold shapes outlined in dark lead, filled with glowing colored glass. Light becomes the artwork.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for spiritual, ornate, or fairytale imagery. Strong silhouettes work best.

keywords.name: Static Hold
keywords.definition: The camera does not move at all; the frame is a stage and life happens inside it.
keywords.when_to_use: Use for composed tableaux, comedy timing, and letting performance breathe.
keywords.prompt_example: "static hold on the doorway as chaos passes through"

keywords.name: Steadicam
keywords.definition: Stabilized floating movement that follows subjects smoothly through space, no track required.

keywords.name: Ukiyo-e Vaporwave
